name: Navigating the Latest Changes in International Student Recruitment in Canada: Insights and Expectations for the Future
description: In recent times, the landscape of international student recruitment has undergone significant shifts, particularly with the introduction of study permit caps by the Canadian government for the years 2024 and 2025. These changes have sparked discussions and raised questions about the future of international education, impacting institutions, providers, and admission specialists worldwide. As Collab International, a Canadian education technology company, we're closely monitoring these developments to ensure informed decision-making and effective strategies for our network of partner universities spanning 17 countries.
